messages.subject: Free webinar on Stan / probabilistic programming tomorrow. 1-2 PM ET
parts:
Hi all,

There's a free webinar tomorrow on probabilistic programming with a focus on Stan. 
https://www.eventbrite.com/e/introduction-to-probabilistic-programming-tickets-31160610224

If you're planning on attending, please register soon. I think there is limited capacity.

The talk is hosted by Fast Forward Labs [Kathryn Hume (head of sales and marketing) and Mike Williams (director of research)] and has Eric Novik (CEO, Stan Group) and me (Stan developer; CTO, Stan Group) talking about Stan for an hour. It should be a good time.

In prepping for this, I reflected on some of the things Stan solved to be as usable as it is. Hopefully I can express how rad this project is within that hour. I'll try to type up my thoughts regardless and post it somewhere public.


Daniel
